findings.claim: Adding a mutating command (e.g. set_parm, create_node) to _READ_ONLY_COMMANDS (handlers.py:204) disarms provenance via the BLESSED invoke()->wrap() path (_is_read_only True -> self._record/write_report skipped; also skips C5 lock + integrity envelope + _submit_logs), yet check_provenance_not_bypassed STILL returns ok=True. Defeats the gate's stated core guarantee, which its docstring claims is impossible. Demonstrated-real: handlers.py:242 already hand-corrects 'cops_temporal_analysis is NOT read-only'. Verified first-hand (probes/prov_taxonomy.py). Fix: 4th static leg asserting mutating-set INTERSECT read-only-set == empty. (Also B1/B2: two-line get-and-call + dict-dispatch evade static leg-3 regex.)
findings.severity: confirmed false-green in stated scope; cheaply closable
